entities.summary: Juraj Nikolac is a Croatian, formerly Yugoslav, chess player who received the FIDE title of Grandmaster (GM) in 1979. He previously held the International Master (IM) title since 1975. Nikolac was born in Metković and is a retired physics teacher. Juraj Nikolac was a journalists & chroniclers from Metković (b. 1932-04-22, Metković). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
